properties.documentation: In the current version of the INSPIRE Consolidated UML model, this package primarily serves as a placeholder to acknowledge the important subject of location referencing as being an important part of a schema for networks.

A reference to an area location related to a network.
This may be the baseclass for many different types of location referencing mechanisms such as: - AGORA-C referencing - Alert-C referencing
The subject is further specified in standards and specifications such as: - ISO 19133 - ISO 17572 (parts 1, 2 and 3) - EuroRoadS - eMotion

Reference to a linear location which is the whole or part of an LRSElement or another linear part of the network.
This may be the baseclass for many different types of location referencing mechanisms such as: - Linear referencing - AGORA-C referencing - Alert-C referencing
The subject is further specified in standards and specifications such as: - ISO 19133 - ISO 17572 (parts 1, 2 and 3) - EuroRoadS - eMotion
The subject of linear referencing is also currently being standardised in ISO 19148.

documentation.value: The location in relation to the linear referencing system

properties.documentation: Reference to a linear location which is the whole or part of an LRSElement.

documentation.value: The location where the linear location reference starts in the linear referencing system
The location where the linear location reference end in the linear referencing system

properties.documentation: Represents a location relative to a network. The reference is the label which is assigned to a location. With a single LRM, one reference must define unambiguously and exactly one location in the location referencing system. The reference is the string of data which is passed between different implementations of a location referencing system to identify the location. [ISO 17572-1]

documentation.value: Identifies the network which is the basis for the location reference

properties.documentation: Represents an element in a linear reference system that can be used for linear references.
